Advanced CRT TV - VCR - VHS Effects
metadata.description: Animated CRT TV and VCR effects that can be used as material and post process effects.
metadata.longDescription:
Demo v1.02 is available!

Download: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1KgvH8MmETTO9Oy_0M31vS5jr1F_jLmon/view?usp=sharing

Demo introduction video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=HvkInz5I9j8


April 2024 minor update! - Revision 10

Fixed texture sample colorspace error for UE 5.

Added timestamp color parameter.


December 2023 update! - Revision 9

Retainer box fix: Dark colors can now be seen on filter that applied on the widgets.


November 2023 update! - Revision 8

Now you can add the CRT/VHS effects on a retainer box to use on HUD widgets. Retainer_Preset_saturated_VCR_distorted material insance can be used as a retainer box effect. You can run the sample level map to see the effect on the example UI widget included.


July 2023 update! - Revision 7

There is a minor fix on screen hop parameters. It changed as:

(Added) Screen Hop Interval - determines the delay on screen hop effect

(Modified) Screen Hop Intensity - determines the glitched hop distance on the screen


P.S. previous versions of master materials are under the legacy_material folder.


September 2021 Update!

Added Features:

Filter On/Off toggler

Glow

Halation

Low/Hi quaility phosphor option

Mipmap control (blurriness)

Better and cheaper scanlines

3D Monitor & TV models

Seed value for variating screen hopping


Jan 2021 update - https://youtu.be/QR9YYobQ-Bo


This Material and post process filter creates adjustable, Animated CRT, and Video Cassette Recorder effects by 47 parameters.

Note: Scene is not included. Only Multisonic TV static mesh is included.

Parameter list and descriptions


CRT Presets: https://youtu.be/ZtmJL2cYJyA

Post Process Presets: https://youtu.be/z6T5CDVQIpY

CRT Close up View: https://youtu.be/DSIDcY4-2hU

Post Process Animation: https://youtu.be/6E9v4EpHvz8

Post Process Material Adjustments: https://youtu.be/xktQPAezp6A

Material adjustment - Creating 8-Bit Computer Screen: https://youtu.be/xRfzgwPWbUg

Material adjustment - Creating VCR Screen: https://youtu.be/-kFGooXIic4

Time Stamp configuration Tutorial: https://youtu.be/q1pmJXZAEy0
metadata.technicalDetails:
General Effects: Chromatic, Distance, Emissive, Intensity / Screen Brightness, Roughness, Multiplier, Saturation/Desaturation, Vertical Trace Ray Intensity, Vertical Trace Ray Repeat, Vertical Trace Ray Speed, Vignette Amount

Scanline Effects: Scanline Count, Scanline Intensity, Scanline Odd Line Clarity, Scanline Vertical Shift Speed

Screen Scale: Screen Scale (Horizontal), Screen Scale (Vertical)

Signal Quality: Random Horizontal Offset Frequency, Random Horizontal Offset Strength, Screen Hop Frequency, Screen Hop Intensity, White Noise Intensity, WhiteNoise Scale

VCR Effects: Color Tornado Intensity, Tracking Noise Density, Tracking Noise Level, Tracking Noise Scale, Warp BeltInt ensity

Monochrome Screen: B&W or Green Screen, Monochrome Screen

Phosphor Settings: Phosphor Ratio (X/Y), Phosphor Scale, Phosphor Visibility, Slot Mask / Shadow Mask

Pixelation: Pixelation Scale, Pixelation Toggle

Time Stamp: Time Stamp Raito (X/Y), Time Stamp Scale, Time Stamp Opacity, Time Stamp Shift (Horizontal), Time Stamp Shift (Vertical) 


January 2021 update!

Signal Distortion

This new effect adds red color based distortion on the screen. Like bad antenna signal reception.

Barrel Distortion

This parameters add adjustable barrel distortion shape and a fake glassy reflection to the screen.

metadata.title: Advanced Flock System
metadata.description: Fish react to any primitive objects with a collision of any complexity and react on any pawn or characters. This plugin uses multithreading.
metadata.longDescription:
Advanced Flock System Is suitable for creating a simulation of a fish herd.

Demo Video, Video 2, Video 3, Video 4 - Uses Tropical Fish asset.

Free support for our products in Discord.


OUR ASSETS

OUR ASSETS 2


Fish Pack 1

Fish Pack 2


Update 1.3.4

+ Fixed issue with different speeds for different number of instances. The animation is now smoother.

+ Small optimization.


Update 1.3 Video

+ New optimization +40% performance (10.000 fish 120+ FPS)

+ Fish can attack the player.

+ Added a piranha with animated material.


Update 1.2 Video - The flock fishes can now follow any actor.

Comparison with Advanced Fly Insects System and Advanced Insects System on Link Google Doc


Easy use! This plugin uses multithreading.

Fish can move in Box or a free-range. Fish react to any primitive objects with a collision of any complexity and react on any pawn or characters.

The core code is realized by C++. The main thread only move instances. In the background, threads calculate all logic flock system for more FPS.

It has a large number of different settings so that you can achieve the desired effect.
metadata.technicalDetails:
Features:

  • 5000 fish instances 120+ FPS. 20000 fish instances 50-60 FPS on AMD Ryzen 5 2700x.
  • You can select the desired number of threads and the number of fish instances!
  •  One C++ class
  •  Two actor blueprint
  •  3 Fish static mesh
  • 1 Aquarium static mesh
  • 3 Materials for fish with animation wings
  • Texture Resolutions 1024x1024
  • One BP class Pawn for testing
  • Doesn't require knowledge of C ++

Code Modules:

  •  AdvancedFlockSystem (Type: Runtime)

Number of Blueprints: 2

Number of C++ Classes: 1

Network Replicated: No

Supported Development Platforms: Win64

Supported Target Build Platforms: Win64

Documentation: GoogleDoc link, Discord

Example Project: Included

Important/Additional Notes: No

metadata.title: Advanced Photo Mode
metadata.description: Capture and immortalize your game's best moments with a photo mode and gallery photo viewer. 100% blueprints, with keyboard/mouse and gamepad support.
metadata.longDescription:
A photo mode in a game is a feature that allows players to capture and customize screenshots of their gameplay experiences. By allowing players to pause the game and manipulate the camera angle, depth of field, filters, and other settings, photo mode offers an opportunity for players to share and celebrate their favorite moments in a game with their friends, family, and online communities.


Implementing a photo mode in a game can provide several benefits for developers. First and foremost, it can increase player engagement and satisfaction, as it encourages players to spend more time exploring and appreciating the game world. metadata.longDescription:
Showcase Video | Documentation | Playable Demo

How To Integrate With ALSv4


Adventurer’s Inventory Kit is an advanced inventory/Equipment system created by blueprints. The modular design of the system will allow you to create your own item types easily. There are also a couple of premade example item types as you can test from the screenshots. Items are using completely separate structures and different data tables. You can easily edit/add your own structure to the system. 


Blueprints are organized and commented. Most of the functions are created in a function library and can be used in any blueprint.

metadata.title: AI for NPC, MetaHuman - Dialog, actions and general intelligence - by Convai
metadata.description: Convai powers NPCs with human-like intelligence.
metadata.longDescription:
Convai enables NPCs with intelligence such that they can converse naturally with players via text or voice and can carry out advanced actions as an enemy, companion, or filler bot. This Unreal plugin has integrations with all of Convai’s APIs to integrate with your characters and game assets. Check out this overview video to learn more about this plugin, and visit the documentation for tutorials and more details. Feel free to write to support@convai.com if you have any issues or questions.






Highlights:

  • Intelligent realtime open-ended conversation capabilities, enabling natural and dynamic interactions.
  • Multiple languages support.
  • Actions: Characters can understand the environment and can perform actions based on conversation, verbal commands, and events, opening up new possibilities.
  • Knowledge Base: You can add potentially unlimited knowledge for your characters making them an expert at a topic or grounding them to the lore of the world and their backstories.
  • Multiplayer support: Voice chat between multiple players and characters.
  • Intelligent Animations: Integrated with Lip-Sync, facial and body animations with conversation flow.




Lip-Sync:

  • Check our quick guide for easy steps on adding the latest High-Quality realtime lipsync to AI characters.




Pixel Streaming Support:

  • Check our quick guide for easy steps on setting up microphone Pixel Streaming with the plugin.



Resources:

  • Quick start video to help you get started quickly and easily.
  • Documentation to guide you through the plugin's features and capabilities.
  • Tutorial series to help you master the plugin's full potential.





Sample Projects:

  • Demo project contains a ReadyPlayerMe and a Metahuman to showcase the plugin's features in action.
  • Actions Sample Project showcases actions such as picking up items and doing custom actions, made in correspondence to the Actions Tutorial.
  • NPC2NPC Sample Project showcases Convai's character to character conversations system, made in correspondence to the NPC2NPC Tutorial.




MacOS Microphone Permission Issue:

  • The Convai plugin requires microphone access in Unreal Engine (UE) 5.0 and 5.3 on MacOS. Find steps on how to enable microphone access here.




Compatibility:

  • Compatible with all character and avatar assets. Metahumans, Daz3D, Reallusion, ReadyPlayerMe, and any humanoid or non-humanoid assets can be integrated. 





Standalone components:

  • Text to Speech (TTS) and Speech to Text (STT) capabilities.
  • Update character based on in-game events. Characters' personalities, backstories, and knowledge can be updated in real-time during gameplay.





Coming soon:

  • Other Platforms (IOS - Linux)
  • Long-term memory for characters.




Unreal Engine 4 compatibility:

  • Compatible with Unreal Engine versions 4.26 and 4.27, check our documentation link for a hassle-free installation process.
  • Note that UE 5.0 version is no longer being updated on the marketplace, you can get the latest 5.0 plugin by following this guide.





Need Support or Have Questions?

  • If you encounter any issues or have questions, feel free to reach out to us at support@convai.com or join the community on Discord Our team is dedicated to providing you with the support you need to make the most out of Convai.


Experience the future of interactive storytelling with our plugin. Sign up today and take your projects to the next level!

Basic Multiplayer Melee Combat System
metadata.description: A set of actor components to facilitate the creation of multiplayer melee combat games
metadata.longDescription:
This project consists of four actor components, and other blueprints, designed to be a good starting point for prototyping, or in the creation process of a simple multiplayer melee action game. Every feature is separated into its own actor component, for implementation flexibility.


Video Demonstration and Tutorials Playlist

Documentation

Playable Demonstration


The main componets are:

  • Basic Montage Sequence Manager - Handles the playback of the montage sequences and sections. ( A plugin version of this component is available for free here. )
  • Combat State Manager - Handles the hit scan, damage, and blocking events.
  • Ragdoll State Manager - Handles all ragdoll-related events.
  • Simple Lock-on - Handles the character and camera lock-on.

Additional Components are:

  • Projectile Spawner - Handles the spawning of projectiles for range based weapons, as well ammo and reloading.
  • Animation Sync - Handles synced animations, used here for combat finishers.

It also includes a three vs three game mode to demonstrate all features, and AI bots (which are automatically added to complete the two teams for the match).


This project is a multiplayer alternative version (simplified in some areas, and expanded in others) of my other marketplace system Basic Melee Combat System. Consider checking it out if you are looking for a melee system focused on single-player, in the style of modern beat 'em ups.
metadata.technicalDetails:
Features:

  • Four modes of hit scan tracing for damage.
  • Aim Offset (for the melee attack be in the aiming direction).
  • First and Third person camera toggle setup.
  • The possibility of “baking” the tracing locations in arrays, for more hit precision in very low frame rate scenarios (Check the documentation for more details).
  • Handling of attack sequences, with support for montage sections.
  • Blocking, Dodging and Shield Bash.
  • Fully network replicated, with a demonstration game mode.
  • Ragdoll state handling.

(Version 2.0)

  • Added support for Ranged based weapons.
  • Added support for combat finishers.


Number of Blueprints: 15

Input: Gamepad, Keyboard, Mouse

Network Replicated: Yes

Supported Development Platforms: Windows


Important/Additional Notes:

  • The project makes use of Enhanced Input, only for demonstration purposes; the components do not require it.
  • The animations included are from the Animation Starter Pack and Epic’s Paragon Graystone, but they are meant just to be placeholders, for demonstration purposes. Currently it uses paragon animations for locomotion, but I"ll implement the Lyra locomotion system soon, including turn in place, 180° turning, etc.
  • Price will increase as more features are added.
  • I'm not a network replication expert, so it is almost certain that the project replication will require optimization in regard to network bandwidth.


Consider joining my recently created Discord Server, for support and questions.

metadata.longDescription:
38 Cloud Textures with unique simple 3D Meshes and

9 Sky Textures 360 degrees rectangular panoramas (equirectangular) with 3D Mesh spheres.

3 Additional panoramas versions


Each Cloud is separate. Each is on a separate Texture with transparency. The exception is 2 groups of clouds "horizon", which are placed together on one Texture.


All components have been created so as to achieve the best visual quality while maintaining simplicity for optimal performance when they are used in modern computers games, mobile devices games, virtual reality and other projects. Meshes, Materials and Textures have been specially prepared to give infinitely many and easy possibilities to customize objects for your unique project.

Creating Portal To Another Reality
metadata.description: This asset allows you to easily create portals to worlds that will be slightly different from the original worlds.
metadata.longDescription:
Demonstration: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=3c1telTrgYM

Update: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=-d4uzt4YSvI

Documentation: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1dr241IMqIYZj3I0w0Q4lYjo-_wm8Lvnk47xL7YEgSLI/edit?usp=sharing (There are new features that appeared after recording the demo. I recommend reading before and after purchase)


Asset works best to create worlds that differ in minor details (and/or materials) from the original worlds.


It is important to understand that the character and objects do not teleport, they only change some of their properties, such as visibility, collision, material, etc.


The principle of work is based on the function of the material, not on RenderTarget with its SceneCapture. The result is a good optimization with perfect quality.


You can create an unlimited number of portals that connect the same worlds or each portal will create its own world (see documentation for details).


Examples of use:

Various puzzles;

Division of the world into 2 parts. For example, the "real world" and the world in the past/future (in the demo it is the white and green world);

Various abstract things, like the non-Euclidean world;

and much more.
metadata.technicalDetails:
Documentation: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1dr241IMqIYZj3I0w0Q4lYjo-_wm8Lvnk47xL7YEgSLI/edit?usp=sharing

Blueprints: 3 basic ones and 7 demonstration childBP.

Material function: 2.

Material parameter collection: 3.

1 basic material and many varieties of it for demonstration.

Interface: 1.


Network Replicated: No. Multiplayer is supported in this asset - https://www.unrealengine.com/marketplace/en-US/product/horror-mechanics-anomaly-detection It has fewer portal functions, but it has its own unique features.


Supported Development Platforms: Windows, SteamVR, Oculus Quest (Possible problems if you pack the project on ue5 for oculus quest. I don't recommend you to buy this Asset if you use ue5 and oculus quest. On earlier versions of the engine everything is fine. Also no problems with other helmets (htc vive, oculus rift, oculus quest in pc mode, etc.)

Customizable Interaction Plugin
metadata.description: Customizable Interaction Plugin - Seamlessly integrate an interaction system with customizable detection modes, widgets and more. Made in C++ for optimization and advanced logic.
metadata.longDescription:
Showcase Video | Example Project | Documentation | Discord Community


Customizable Interaction Plugin introduces an easily implementable interaction plugin, encompassing numerous customization choices. These include various interaction modes, distinct detection modes, a customizable widget, and much more. Written entirely in C++, Customizable Interaction Plugin was developed to achieve maximum optimization while retaining advanced customization options.
metadata.technicalDetails:
Features:

  • Easy Customizable - All Options Can Be Customized via Data Tables
  • Interactor And Interactable Components - Used to Easily Implement The Interaction System in Your On Blueprints or C++ Classes. 
  • Multi Detection Modes - Proximity From Screen Center and Proximity From Character. (Customizable Distance)
  • Multi Interaction Modes - Single Press, Hold. 
  • Hover, Overlap And Interaction Sounds - All of the sounds can be Customized.
  • Physics Simulated Interactables - Interaction Supports Physics Simulated Objects.
  • Customizable Widget - Easily Customizable Widget including different shapes, different Shortcuts and more.


Number of Blueprints: 12

Number of C++ Classes: 5

Network Replicated: Yes

Supported Development Platforms: Windows

Supported Target Build Platforms: All

metadata.description: Deep Elder Caves
metadata.title: Deep Elder Caves
Deep Elder Caves
metadata.description: A large set of various underground fantasy assets made in a D&D theme for perfect creation of deep dark caves.
metadata.longDescription:
Youtube Video preview


Youtube Video Pack Features


Panoramic Screenshots


The Deep Elder Caves contains assets in different variations such as walls, arches, floors, pillars, rocks, tiny habitat statues, coins, chests, mushrooms, ancient fallen head statues, roots (mesh + alpha), shrubs, a skeleton set (solid in different poses + piles, skulls), and other smaller stuff. Perfect for use in fantasy RPG\Actions games.

In the demonstration map you will find different examples of usage: either as a dark, classic cold cave, or something warmer with mushrooms and a fantasy vibe.


One specific feature of using architectural modular parts is that you are be able to scale up\down these pieces (walls, pillars, etc.) without losing accurate texel density. Simply speaking, the UV mapping stays the same, which gives you more control when creating levels.


Pack features:

  • 250 AAA quality assets of different kinds overall
  • 29 architectural modular objects for building cave interiors
  • 178 prop assets
  • Huge and small fantasy mushrooms
  • Rocks of any size
  • Skeleton set
  • Treasure chests in 3 colors with coins
  • Decals for visual enrichment
  • Well optimized LOD’s for all meshes
  • Efficient usage of packed ORM texture maps
  • Easy customizable master materials
  • Blending between materials with vertex color painting on tileable mats
  • Completed cave environment for demonstration

Defender: Animated Dialogue System
metadata.description: Defender: Animated Dialogue System is an easy to use and very flexible dialogue creator with typewriter text animation, different choices, triggering events, bubble above characters, text-formatting, gamepad support, cinematic mode and much more!
metadata.longDescription:
Defender: Animated Dialogue System is an easy to use and very flexible dialogue creator with typewriter text animation, dialogue branches(multiple choices), triggering events, bubble above characters, text-formatting, gamepad support, cinematic mode and much more!


This asset contains a Animated Dialogue System which is a feature of Defender: Top-Down Shooter Template. You can check our other products from this link.


❖ Showcase product during 16th May - 30th May 2023 ❖


🕹️ Demo

  • Playable Demo Download


🎞️ Videos

  • Trailer
  • All How-To Videos
  • ✈️ Migration to another project (Don't forget to backup! Also Enable "Enhanced Input Plugin" in your project. This is not mentioned in this video because we added Enhanced Inputs in the newest release.)
  • 🎭 How to make the interaction system work?
  • 🎮 How to make gamepad controller settings when migrating to a new project
  • 🎨 How to change widget colors?


❓ Need Support?

  • Discord: Discord Link
  • Documentation: Link


💡With this system, you can do the following operations:

  • Easily create dialogues using datatables.
  • Create Dialogue branches with Stat requirements.
  • Add Audio to dialogue rows.
  • Continue from a certain row when dialogue restarts.
  • Trigger events from Level Blueprint in dialogue.
  • Add dialogue bubbles to characters or actors.
  • Activate custom cinematic mode and blending view targets to a camera.
  • Add waypoints to NPCs.
  • The possibilities are limitless!
  • All features have How-to videos. Get started and learn easily!


💡FEATURES

  • %100 Blueprint and well commented.
  • Educational blueprint design with a lot of examples.
  • Full gamepad support.
  • DialogueComp to show in-game dialogues
  • Dialogue Bubbles to show dialogue bubble above NPCs
  • Typewriter effect in dialogue text.
  • 4 Stats for use in dialogues: Reasoning, Manipulation, Intimidation, Karma. You can add your own Stats!
  • Cinematic bars widget
  • Includes Paragon Twinblast Specops, Paragon Greystone Novaborn
  • Component-based design. You can use in-game components to any games you want.
  • Event-driven system to optimize logic. No need to make heavy casting operations between blueprints.
  • Partitioned Save/Load System
  • Footsteps with surface support.
  • BP_CameraTrackerVolume (Fixed camera tracking volume)
  • NPC AI with behavior trees.
  • FadeMeshComp to fading meshes between camera and the main character.
  • Multi-message feature to show multiple in-game messages efficiently.
  • A PROJECT DEVELOPED WITH YEARS OF GAME DEVELOPER EXPERIENCE!


Please make a copy of your previous project before updating with new versions.

Project Requirement: This project requires the Common UI Plugin provided free of charge by Epic Games.


Disclaimer: For demonstration purposes, this product uses some assets from "Lyra", "Action RPG", "Blueprints", "Paragon", "Paragon: Male Announcer", "Content Examples", "Third Person" distributed free of charge by Epic Games
The Orbitron font is taken from the Lyra Template provided free by Epic Games.

  • Trigger events from Level Blueprint in dialogue.
  • Add dialogue bubbles to characters or actors.
  • Activate custom cinematic mode and blending view targets to a camera.
  • Add waypoints to NPCs.

  • All features have How-to videos. Get started and learn easily!

  • %100 Blueprint and well commented.
  • Educational blueprint design with a lot of examples.
  • Full gamepad support.
  • DialogueComp to show in-game dialogues
  • Dialogue Bubbles to show dialogue bubble above NPCs
  • Typewriter effect in dialogue text.
  • 4 Stats for use in dialogues: Reasoning, Manipulation, Intimidation, Karma. You can add your own Stats!
  • Cinematic bars widget
  • Includes Paragon Twinblast Specops, Paragon Greystone Novaborn
  • Component-based design. You can use in-game components to any games you want.
  • Event-driven system to optimize logic. No need to make heavy casting operations between blueprints.
  • Partitioned Save/Load System
  • Footsteps with surface support.
  • BP_CameraTrackerVolume (Fixed camera tracking volume)
  • NPC AI with behavior trees.
  • FadeMeshComp to fading meshes between camera and the main character.
  • Multi-message feature to show multiple in-game messages efficiently.
  • A PROJECT DEVELOPED WITH YEARS OF GAME DEVELOPER EXPERIENCE!


Please make a copy of your previous project before updating with new versions.

Project Requirement: This project requires the Common UI Plugin provided free of charge by Epic Games.


Disclaimer: For demonstration purposes, this product uses some assets from "Lyra", "Action RPG", "Blueprints", "Paragon", "Paragon: Male Announcer", "Content Examples", "Third Person" distributed free of charge by Epic Games
The Orbitron font is taken from the Lyra Template provided free by Epic Games.

This plugin offers you the ability to utilize Steam and Epic Games Store DLC systems for your project with blueprints using a single modular node design. It is designed to fit in with any project and be very easy to use while also powerful in feature sets.


IMPORTANT: Players must be connected to the internet at time of use of the plugin or the steam/EGS systems cannot be reached.


Features(Steam Platform):

  • Check if DLC and/or the game is purchased and installed on the players Steam account.
  • Open the store page for targeted game or DLC via the Steam overlay with a single blueprint node(Steam Only).
  • Ability to open any webpage such as your games website, a social media profile, or anything else you might have all from a single blueprint node within the Steam overlay.
  • Anti-Piracy protection by allowing you to code your game logic with Steam ownership verification.


Features(Epic Games Store Platform):

  • Check if DLC or game is purchased on players epic games account.
  • Open a checkout window within the epic games store overlay for quick in-game purchases(EGS Only).
  • Ability to quickly and easily add microtransactions to your game via Epic Games Store.
  • Anti-Piracy protection by allowing you to code your game logic with Epic Games Store ownership verification.
  • Retrieve information about the game and its DLC such as its price, title, description, release/expiration date, and more from within blueprints, great for automating widget changes for an in-game store such as automatic price changes from a sale.
  • Login the player automatically from the Epic Games launcher to enable overlay and other EGS online features with a single node.


If the plugin works well for you then please be sure to leave a review letting us know what you liked about it.

This plugin offers you the ability to utilize Steam and Epic Games Store DLC systems for your project with blueprints using a single modular node design. It is designed to fit in with any project and be very easy to use while also powerful in feature sets.


IMPORTANT: Players must be connected to the internet at time of use of the plugin or the steam/EGS systems cannot be reached.


Features(Steam Platform):

  • Check if DLC and/or the game is purchased and installed on the players Steam account.
  • Open the store page for targeted game or DLC via the Steam overlay with a single blueprint node(Steam Only).
  • Ability to open any webpage such as your games website, a social media profile, or anything else you might have all from a single blueprint node within the Steam overlay.
  • Anti-Piracy protection by allowing you to code your game logic with Steam ownership verification.


Features(Epic Games Store Platform):

  • Check if DLC or game is purchased on players epic games account.
  • Open a checkout window within the epic games store overlay for quick in-game purchases(EGS Only).
  • Ability to quickly and easily add microtransactions to your game via Epic Games Store.
  • Anti-Piracy protection by allowing you to code your game logic with Epic Games Store ownership verification.
  • Retrieve information about the game and its DLC such as its price, title, description, release/expiration date, and more from within blueprints, great for automating widget changes for an in-game store such as automatic price changes from a sale.
  • Login the player automatically from the Epic Games launcher to enable overlay and other EGS online features with a single node.


If the plugin works well for you then please be sure to leave a review letting us know what you liked about it.

The latest collection in the Dreamscape series is here! Built from the ground up for customization and performance it features a large collection of AAA quality assets to build next-gen stylized environments.

  • Stylized particle effects.

metadata.title: EP Master Materials
metadata.description: Create any PBR materials with good optimized game ready master materials pack for walls and props with full customization at any time of development.
metadata.longDescription:
Forum pack discussion thread

Documentation: https://drive.google.com/open?id=12qf3h0kW_K3b1W82Gv1C5A3jnSO8aKhD

Video demonstration of master materials pack: https://youtu.be/3gQthCh3QB0

Demonstration of work Grunge Wall - vertex paint material: https://youtu.be/iRzng2amqX4

Demonstration of test materials pack in VR: https://youtu.be/09CukvHoA1A


Eye Perfection is an advanced master materials pack with optimized performance, prepared especially to use with any types of PBR materials for game props and modular walls, like ground dirt floor/cracked plaster walls/metallic walls with erosion and other. The pack has demonstrative materials with presets of POM/Displacement/Vertex Paint/Emissive settings for great performance. A great solution for improving your knowledge and save a lot of time by purchasing this game ready master materials pack. Low load performance impact with use ONLY what you need approach. Designed and optimized for PC/VR games.

With these master materials, I have made 80 material instances with certain types to help you get started customizing and use materials in game.  

Save your time and use all mostly needed generic features of shader materials like: distance-based tesselation/POM/Vertex Paint/Emissive/SubSurface & etc.
metadata.technicalDetails:
Features:

  • 9 Production-ready Customizable Master Materials
  • 80 Template Material Instances & Examples
  • Compact Material Functions Library Included 184 assets
  • A lot customization options. Over 1800 parameters to make it fully customizable. Additionally, Over 600 switches allows controlling efficiency-quality trade off.
  • Distance-based tessellation (UE 4.20 - 4.27), with customizable settings applied across all layers by default.
  • Displacement tessellation for Nanite (UE 5.3 - 5.4)
  • Supports 3 types of vertex paint - with water, grunge wall & default full customization setup.
  • Triplanar UV Projection Mapping
  • Normal Map Generation + Optimization calculation
  • Emissive + Cropping + Cloud Panner & Glow effects
  • Albedo color adjustment with fuzzy shading & subsurface color control
  • Efficient and GPU friendly. Uses between 100-270 instructions depending on the number of features enabled, can be used on VR.


Texture Resolutions:

  • (46) 2048x2048
  • (1) 2048x1024
  • (2) 512x512
  • (1) 128x128


Do Materials derive from a Master Material with instances as variation: Yes

Number of Textures: 50

Number of Maps: 3

Supported Development Platforms: PC, VR

Flat Nodes
metadata.description: A minimalist style for nodes, flatter, that makes graphs clearer and more readable.
metadata.longDescription:
A minimalist style for Unreal Engine graph nodes. This plugin adds a simplified visual appearance, flatter, that makes graphs clearer and more readable I think.


There is no impact on the engine's performance and stability, only the UI's visual aspect is changed: just some super tiny .png files used by Slate are replaced.


It works well on UE4 and UE5 since these files have not changed and the visual appearance of the graph nodes uses these same files.
metadata.technicalDetails:
Features:

  • Graph nodes flat style
  • Few plugin settings [New in 5.0+] : Choose between gradient or true flat header - Brightness control over flat header


Code Modules: FlatNodes (Editor)

Supported Development Platforms: Win64, Win32, Mac, Linux

Source Code: https://github.com/brumenn/FlatNodes

metadata.description:
В Fortnite есть всё, что вы любите. 

Играйте в любимых режимах или открывайте что-то новое с товарищами, становитесь последним выжившим в «Королевской битве», предавайтесь ностальгии в Fortnite: «Как раньше», продумывайте каждый шаг в «Перезарядке», возглавляйте хит-парады в Fortnite Festival, исследуйте миры в LEGO Fortnite — здесь вы всегда можете найти что-то новое для себя и друзей.

Играйте в тысячи игр от разработчиков — полосы препятствий, экономические игры, гонки, выживание с зомби и многое другое! Или же создавайте с помощью Unreal Editor для Fortnite (UEFN) и инструментов творческого режима Fortnite собственные игры, в которые смогут играть абсолютно все.  Каждая игра имеет собственный возрастной рейтинг, поэтому вы всегда сможете легко найти то, что подойдёт вам.

metadata.title: Fortnite
Gathering Resources - Advanced System
metadata.description: A easy to plug-in system that allow you to spawn resources and gather them with necessary tools. Additionally jackpot mini-game is implemented inside. All mades in blueprints - just edit and go. Brilliant time-saver!
metadata.longDescription:
>> Newly Created Discord << Questions & Support

>> DOCUMENTATION <<

>>VIDEO PRESENTATION<<


MULTIPLAYER SUPPORTED

⮞ Easy for everyone to plug-in system that allow you to spawn resources and gather them with necessary tools.

⮞ Additionally jackpot mini-game is implemented inside.

⮞ All stuff are created in customizable and modularable way.

⮞ Sorted, commented and well organized blueprints - very easily you will find yourself in, even if you are beginner.





Brilliant time-saver! Editing and adding stuff takes only few clicks!


This system allow you to:

  • setup gathering tools and connect them with appopriated resources,
  • setup resources and their destructable version,
  • customize resources enchanments based of determined probabilities,
  • setup all neccesery informations for advanced resource like their health, amount of resource player will get, tier, enchantment, particle color, probability of occurence and more,
  • setup additional bonus game that appear based of your needs ( the gathering-game allows player to get more amount of resource depends of the result of mini-game )
  • paint eveyrything via foliage tool


Inside project you will find additionaly:

  • crystal material resource,
  • material onHit vfx,
  • resource enchantment vfx,
  • item vfx,
  • 3x Resources with their destructable counterparts ( Crystal, Gold, Stone ),
  • proper UI for this kind of mini game,
  • sounds
  • default Gathering Animation
  • and more...


Check my other projects, perfectly fitting to this one:

  • Crafting items - advanced system

metadata.title: interactive Open World Foliage
metadata.description: This asset will give you the opportunity to fill your ground with dense foliage with minimal loss of performance.
metadata.longDescription:
The purpose of this asset is to give you a affordable opportunity to fill your ground with dense foliage with small loss of performance.


The grass of this asset is having no shader complexity combined with a minimal quad overdraw. This is made possible by the usage of a pure mesh implementation with only one triangle per blade of grass. The textures are made of scanned vegetation to make it look very natural. With the usage of many different flower types you can now generate large open world fields with a high culling radius.


All vegetation can interact with your character.


  • Content and Performance Trailer


If you are looking for a more realistic looking grass with a great optimization take a look here:

  • [interactive optimized Grass Library]


For the best possible support for this and many other products join our Discord!

[join Discord Community]

  • 6 different types of flowers with 2 clusters each

metadata.title: Landscape Pro 2.0 Auto-Generated Material
metadata.description: High-Quality Landscape Material with Lots of Features, many Meshes, Textures, and Know-How.
metadata.longDescription:
Video Presentation + Feature 1

Video Feature 2

Video Performance

Documentation

http://www.stf3d.de


Hello Everyone.

Landscape Pro 2.0 is just released and is now much more optimized for open world maps. Check out the performance video. Our as-of-yet biggest submission is designed to be a great time-saver for every indie developer and professional studio alike.


Our auto-generated LandscapePro Material was created over a process of more than 2 years. In this time, a lot of R&D was spent trying to find out the best techniques to create a Landscape Material that is both highly performant and beautiful to look at, while saving you as a developer huge amounts of time.

As you can see in our video, rocks will be drawn automatically without distortion and offer high detail due to the implementation of tessellation into the material. There is a total of 7 Landscape Layers included, each assisting you in the placement of different prop groups (plants, stones and other objects) across your landscape. We have also included trees with wind support, ground plants, ferns, grasses and water materials. LandscapePro is highly customizable, so you can feed your own content into it easily. Considering all the hard work that has gone into it, we think it's a fair deal; we love video games - and we know how much it helps if you don't have to do every bit of the work all by yourself. Just focus on what you really want to do!

Line Of Sight. Dynamic mesh.
metadata.description: Create Line Of Sight (Field of vision) for object detection or use in postprocess.
metadata.longDescription:
The component creates a field of view (Field of vision) and allows you to detect objects. It can also be used in postprocess for a pseudo lighting and fog of war effect.

Easy use in blueprint.


  • 2 geometric types: arch and line.
  • Creates 2 arches.
  • Rotate along X, Y, Z. Not only Z (Top-Down games).
  • High performance, the component is written in C ++.
  • Can be used in 3D and 2D games.
  • Can be used for pseudo lighting (example in the screenshot).
  • Easy to use in blueprint. For minimal functionality, only two functions need to be called.
  • Additional functions for interpolation of angles, radius, rotation. Watch the video preview.
  • Can be executed on a server in a multiplayer game.
  • Detection of enemies occurs even if the mesh is invisible.


The only "Line Of Sight" plugin on the market with support for two arches, two types of geometric shapes (line and arch), reverse arch, texture support and the fastest.



Video preview: YouTube

Full documentation: Here and Here

Video tutorial on Youtube: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=mc9eZHbbu30 basic functions

Manual - creating pseudo lighting (Text): Here

Create pseudo lighting (Youtube): Here

Forum Thread (Support): Here
metadata.technicalDetails:
Code Modules: LineOfSight (Runtime).

Number of C++ Classes: 1

Network Replicated: No (The component can be run on the client and on the server. To notify other players, create a Custom Event with replication -> Multicast).

Supported Development Platforms: Any (Windows, Mac, Linux)

Supported Target Build Platforms: Any (Tested on Windows 10 and Android 7)

metadata.title: Line Of Sight. Dynamic mesh.
metadata.description: Create Line Of Sight (Field of vision) for object detection or use in postprocess.
metadata.longDescription:
The component creates a field of view (Field of vision) and allows you to detect objects. It can also be used in postprocess for a pseudo lighting and fog of war effect.

Easy use in blueprint.


  • 2 geometric types: arch and line.
  • Creates 2 arches.
  • Rotate along X, Y, Z. Not only Z (Top-Down games).
  • High performance, the component is written in C ++.
  • Can be used in 3D and 2D games.
  • Can be used for pseudo lighting (example in the screenshot).
  • Easy to use in blueprint. For minimal functionality, only two functions need to be called.
  • Additional functions for interpolation of angles, radius, rotation. Watch the video preview.
  • Can be executed on a server in a multiplayer game.
  • Detection of enemies occurs even if the mesh is invisible.


The only "Line Of Sight" plugin on the market with support for two arches, two types of geometric shapes (line and arch), reverse arch, texture support and the fastest.

metadata.title: Low Poly Nature: Lush and Diverse Environments
metadata.description: Bring your game to life with over 800 low poly 3D models. Inspired by real-world flora, discover a diverse range of models to craft your dream world.
metadata.longDescription:
Demonstration video


🍃 Welcome to the Low Poly Nature Pack!


Ever dreamt of creating a lush, vivid game world but not sure where to start? Say hello to the Low Poly Nature pack, the ultimate asset toolkit designed with you in mind.


⚠️Works perfectly with our newly released Forgotten Graveyards 🪦asset pack! ⚠️


🌳 What’s Inside?


Over 800 High Quality Game Ready 3D Models: From whimsical mushrooms to towering oaks, everything you need to paint a vivid picture.

  • Flora: Bushes & shrubs, grass blades & lumps, mushrooms & more.
  • Terrain: A wide range of ground pieces, including background mountains and floating islands.
  • Props: Add life with campfires, ruined walls and modular fences.
  • Geological Features: Rocks, pebbles, and cliffs.
  • Stunning Trees: From majestic oaks to whimsical weeping willows.


✨ Key Features:

  • Real-World Inspiration: Many of the models aren't just generic plants; we strived for botanical accuracy, while still maintaining low poly aesthetics and artistic freedom. This includes different growth stages for some of the models.
  • Easy Customization: Swap out colors easily with single texture atlas / palette texture. Annotated variant included.
  • Nanite and Lumen ready: Compatible with Unreal Engine's Nanite and Lumen technologies. Nanite is enabled for static meshes in 5.x version of the asset pack. Please visit the Lumen and Nanite documentation for more info.


🔍Details:

  • Bushes: 40, including 15 shrubs
  • Cliffs: 5
  • Grass: 80 models, including more and less detailed version, with variations (lush, dried, mixed)
  • Ground: 69 models, including Background Mountains (5), Flat 4m tiles (20), Floating Islands (6), Low Hills (6), Mounds (16) and Small piles (16)
  • Mushrooms: 83 models, including Death Caps (1), Fly Agaric (22), Girolles (9), Parasol Mushrooms (13), Procini (12), Shaggy Ink Cap (15) and generic mushrooms (2)
  • Plants: 196 models, including Bluebells (9), Daisies (15), Dandelions (13), Ferns (13), Foxgloves (9), Ivy (52: 20 complex, 20 simplified variants and 10 clusters, and 2 leaves), Nettles (36), Reeds (9), Water Lilies (22) and Wild Garlic (12), generic saplings (6)
  • Rocks: 35 models, including 9 rock piles
  • Simple water planes: 15 models of tillable meshes
  • Trees: 110 models, including Birches (18), Oaks (17), Pines (51), Weeping Willow (14), generic trees (10)
  • Tree branches: 13 models
  • Tree logs: 42 models, including log piles (12)
  • Tree trunks/stumps: 19 models
  • Tree roots: 6 models
  • Withered Trees: 15 models
  • Modular fence: 50 models
  • Campfires: 10 models (2 types of campfires in 3 stages, firewood and stone)
  • Ruined walls: 13 models, including 6 walls, 2 rubbles and 5 stone slabs
  • Planks: 7 models
  • Textures: 4 variants of palette texture (baseline, vibrant, toned down, flat)

 

Start crafting your dream game today. Let the Low Poly Nature pack be your guide, brush, and canvas all rolled into one.


Engage with us! If you have ideas or feedback join our discord community or write to us!
metadata.technicalDetails:
Features: See description for detailed breakdown

Number of Unique Meshes: 808

Collision: automatically generated

Vertex Count: 189643, 4-3000, with typical being 200-800

LODs: No

Number of Materials and Material Instances: 2 base materials, 5 material instances

Number of Textures: 5

Texture Resolutions: 512x512

Supported Development Platforms: All Platforms

Important/Additional Notes: This pack is primarily centered on 3D models and comes with maps, simple materials, and textures. Please be aware that particle effects and the low poly water shader seen in the demonstration and screenshots are Unreal Engine starter content and external assets, respectively, and are not included in this pack

The demo map features dense foliage; use console commands like foliage.DensityScale 0.2 to adjust density on lower-end hardware if performance issues arise.

metadata.description: The Pack is designed, drawing inspiration from Mediterranean townships. With this package, you can create the town of your dreams down to the finest detail.
metadata.longDescription:
Modular wall models with various variations allow you to design different buildings, and you can create roofs for these buildings in 2 or 4 angled shapes. The package content enables you to design buildings in rectangular, square, U-shaped, and O-shaped forms. It supports your outdoor arrangements with street props, various decals, landscape plants, cliffs, rocks, and marketplace props. Additionally, modular structures provide the opportunity to create indoor spaces. While not as detailed as outdoor areas, you can still design the interior of each house. Doors and window shutters are operable. The package includes a map named "Old Town" as an example of package usage. The package is entirely inspired by Mediterranean townships. Detailed information is available on the Documentation.


Update 1.0 : Models of walls compatible with openable windows and one window have been added. The added window utilizes the classic LOD system and features transparent glass material.


Note: All modular meshes in this package are prepared in accordance with the Unreal Engine Grid system. Additionally, the package utilizes Nanite and Lumen systems. Notes about performance are available within the documentation.

keyImages.alt: Nobody Wants to Die Offer
Download Nobody Wants to Die Offer

metadata.longDescription:
<!--textBlock-->
<!--title-->
# Время раскрывает все секреты
<!--text-->
Добро пожаловать в мрачный Нью-Йорк 2329 года, где люди обрели великий дар — бессмертие, за которое однако кому-то нужно платить. Едва не погибнув, детектив Джеймс Карра берётся за неофициальное дело, в котором ему помогает только юная полицейская атташе Сара Каи. Вместе они следуют по пути серийного убийцы и используют время, чтобы раскрыть тёмные тайны городской элиты.
<!--textBlock-->
<!--title-->
# Добро пожаловать в Нью-Йорк 2329 года
<!--text-->
Отправьтесь в нуарное путешествие по Нью-Йорку образца 2329 года, где технологии наделили людей вечной жизнью, предоставив им возможность хранить своё сознание в банках памяти или переносить его из тела в тело. Но только по подписке.
<!--textBlock-->
<!--title-->
# Ведите расследование
<!--text-->
Станьте детективом отдела смертности и отправьтесь в погоню за серийным убийцей, устроившим охоту на городскую элиту. Осматривайте места преступлений с помощью устройства управления временем и продвинутых технологий, чтобы восстановить цепочку событий, приведших к каждому из убийств, и узнать жуткую правду о жертвах и обстоятельствах их гибели.
<!--textBlock-->
<!--title-->
# Настоящий нуар
<!--text-->
С головой погрузитесь в мрачное будущее этого многозначительного и оригинального интерактивного детектива, исследующего опасности трансгуманизма и бессмертия. В мире вечной жизни, где смерть почти позабыта, а нравственность исчезает на глазах, вам, бывалому детективу, придётся встать на тонкую грань между добром и злом и пройти по ней к путь к суровой правде.
<!--textBlock-->
<!--title-->
# Красивейшее повествование
<!--text-->
Благодаря всей мощи движка Unreal Engine 5 игра Nobody Wants to Die расширяет границы повествования, объединяя фотореалистичную графику и по-настоящему уникальный нарратив.

NPC Optimizator - it's a plugin provide you flexible automatic NPC optimization for you game.

metadata.title: Old West Learning
metadata.description: Check out the description for more information about this project from Epic Online Learning.
metadata.longDescription:
Check out our Tips for Learning Unreal Engine from the Epic Online Learning Team featuring this project on the Epic Developer Community site.


Explore Northwood, USA -- This lumbertown situated in the lower drylands along the river coming down from the mountains hosts the workers and residents of Northwood. This small lumber and work based town is used to float lumber from high up in the mountains down to be processed and then taken into neighboring cities for use.


  • 6+ Unique building structures built in parts to allow for reuse and reconstruction of
  • additional structures
  • Riverbed and ravine space to allow VFX lesson to explore and showcase fluid sims
  • 4 interior spaces set dressed for exploring as player character
  • Landscape spline based roads and tracks
  • Multiple modular bridge and walkway structures
  • Collisions and level setup for design usage and interactivity
  • Lighting, post processing, and cameras to showcase the space


Updated February 20, 2023

  • Fixed some Shadowing issues in the main map
  • Fixed various texture sizes being incorrect

  • If you wish to use static lighting from demo level turn off lumen in project settings - rendering - Global illumination - none
  • Lightmass settings info in overview level (UE5)

Plugin Builder
metadata.description: Adds a tools menu to build plugin with multiple engine versions and compress the built plugin into a zip file that can be submitted to the marketplace.
metadata.longDescription: Adds a tools menu to build plugin with multiple engine versions and compress the built plugin into a zip file that can be submitted to the marketplace.
metadata.technicalDetails:
Usage:

You can access the functionality of this plugin from Package Plugin in the editor's Build menu (File menu in UE4).

From the menu, you can specify the engine version to build, the platform, and whether to strictly determine inclusion, etc.

Code Modules:

  •  PluginBuilder [EditorNoCommandlet]

Supported Development Platforms: Windows

Documentation: https://github.com/Naotsun19B/PluginBuilder-Document

Latest Update:

  • Added support for UE5.4
  • In UE5.3, using "Strict Includes" will cause a build error in the engine code, so we have taken measures to prevent it from being used automatically only in UE5.3
  • Added three settings items: "No Host Platform", "Host Platforms", and "Unversioned"

metadata.title: Post-Soviet Village
metadata.description: Very modular and highly detailed slavic village with many props and interiors
metadata.longDescription:
Lighting\exposure quck fix: go to Post-Process Volume, check the box that says Min EV100 and change it to 2 (or any number that fits your preferences)


Playable online demo

Video

How to use vertex paint in my projects (use Red channel to paint\erase snow)


The architecture is mostly Russian and Eastern European.

This asset pack has fully procedural snow and many variations of modular houses' parts. It's up to you to make a happy freshly-built village or a gloomy and abandoned environment with ruined homes.

The first example map is a vast winter scenery. The second one is to demonstrate the summer version of the asset pack.
metadata.technicalDetails:

  • A landscape with a multi-layered Landscape Material and customizable tessellation.

metadata.technicalDetails:
Features:

  • Quest and dialogs system.
  • Simultaneous quests.
  • Complete, fail and abandon quests.
  • Multiple starts and ends for quests or dialogs.
  • Multiple NPCs per quest supported.
  • Supports non-linear quests and dialogs, with multiple paths.
  • Can have timers inside quests. (Timer task.)
  • Conditional tasks and branching.
  • Customizable tasks objects. Create any task you need for your game.
  • Premade tasks. System tasks and conditions. Reach location. Timers and delays.
  • Rewards system.
  • Heavily exposed to blueprints.
  • Multiplayer.
  • System savegame for player progress.

  • In-editor and real time debugging and visualization.
  • Supports localization.
  • Includes examples of Quests, Dialogs, Blueprints, Datatables, Game UI and Tasks, for easier setup and understanding of the system.

metadata.title: Quixel Bridge
metadata.description: Quixel Bridge for UE5 opens up as a tab right within the engine, giving you unlimited access to thousands of Megascans available for you to drag and drop straight into your Unreal Engine projects.
metadata.longDescription:
Quixel Bridge comes pre-installed with early access release of Unreal Engine 5. To open it up, simply select Quixel Bridge via the Content dropdown in the toolbar, or from the Content Browser.


Bridge for Unreal Engine works with your Epic Games account and currently supports the Unreal Unlimited plan. You can log in using your existing account, or sign up for a new one for free, unlimited access to the Megascans library.
metadata.technicalDetails:
Direct drag and drop: Just drag and drop an asset from the Bridge panel into your scene and a preview mesh will appear instantly. You can place, scale, rotate, and instance it to your liking. The high-res asset will download in the background, and replace the preview mesh automatically.


Built and calibrated for Unreal Engine: The entire Megascans library is optimized to work flawlessly with Unreal Engine 5. Assets are now channel packed, compressed with optimal settings, and LODed with Unreal Engine tools.


Nanite ready: Each Megascans asset is optimized to work with the Nanite system in Unreal Engine. That means you can now add photorealistic, film-quality assets directly into your project without hurting its performance.


Supported Development Platforms: Windows, Mac and Linux

Documentation: Quixel Bridge for UE5

Renovation simulator
metadata.description: Create your own renovation game with tools and features that adapt to your simulator. Whether you want to renovate, create or modify an environment, Renovation Simulator is for you!
metadata.longDescription:
If you have any questions or need support, you can join the Discord server below: Discord channel

Create your own renovation game with tools and features that adapt to your simulator. Whether you want to renovate, create or modify an environment, Renovation Simulator is for you!


Features:

  • Day/Night Cycle with clock
  • Interaction tablet
  • Monetary system
  • Collecting garbage
  • Cleaning dirt
  • Painting walls, doors, pillars and ceilings (2 separate sides)
  • Repairing fences
  • Selection wheel
  • Sell items
  • Leveling and XP gain system
  • Interaction system (With outline)
  • Structures meshes (Wall, door, stairs & pillar)
  • Pause menu
  • FPS counter, Crosshair


The functionalities are updated and added regularly, do not hesitate to make your request.


Latest updates:

May

- Now available in version Unreal Engine 5.4

September

- Now available in version Unreal Engine 5.3

If you have any questions or need support, you can join the Discord server below: Discord channel

Create your own renovation game with tools and features that adapt to your simulator. Whether you want to renovate, create or modify an environment, Renovation Simulator is for you!


Features:

  • Day/Night Cycle with clock
  • Interaction tablet
  • Monetary system
  • Collecting garbage
  • Cleaning dirt
  • Painting walls, doors, pillars and ceilings (2 separate sides)
  • Repairing fences
  • Selection wheel
  • Sell items
  • Leveling and XP gain system
  • Interaction system (With outline)
  • Structures meshes (Wall, door, stairs & pillar)
  • Pause menu
  • FPS counter, Crosshair


The functionalities are updated and added regularly, do not hesitate to make your request.


Latest updates:

May

- Now available in version Unreal Engine 5.4

September

- Now available in version Unreal Engine 5.3

July

﻿- Fixed an issue when quickly picking up trash

metadata.title: Replicated Building System
metadata.description: With the Replicated Building System, you will be able to use your Items as you wish.
metadata.longDescription:
Take a look at the to Showcase examine the product.

Documentation to learn about the product.

For Support, Suggestions please visit the Discord.


Update V4

  • Replication Improvement
  • Bug Fix


Update V3

  • Added Skeletal Mesh Support


Updated V2

  • Added interactivity for Crosshair.
  • Debug style changed.
  • Added function to spawn and use item.
  • A variable named "Snap Trace Length" has been added so that you can adjust the trace length from the arrows you add to control hits.
  • A variable named "Debug for Disable Materials" has been added so that when you activate it, your item will keep its original materials.
  • Added function to update the actor you have taken to its old place.


You can use your items as you wish with many features of the replicated building system. It provides you a lot of convenience with various modes.

Models in the picture are not included!
metadata.technicalDetails:
Features:

  • Singleplayer or Multiplayer support!
  • You can rotate your item
  • You can reset your item's rotation
  • You can take your stuff back and forth
  • You can zoom in or out your item to your character.
  • You can setthe zoom in and out limits.
  • You can have your item auto-snap
  • You can filter your item to auto-snap
  • You can easily change the customizable valid and not valid materials.
  • You can easily change valid and not valid colors.


Number of Blueprints: 9

Network Replicated: Yes ✔️

Supported Development Platforms: Windows, Mac

Supported Target Build Platforms: Windows, Mac, Linux, Android, iOS

metadata.title: Rocket League®
Safe House
metadata.description: A post apocalyptic safe house environment.
metadata.longDescription:
This is a story-driven Real-Time environment art using more than 400 assets featuring a post-apocalyptic warehouse that has been transformed into a safe house.

The quality of the assets are using AAA standards and it's ready to be used in your games and it comes with a well-composited level suitable for lighting artists to do lighting practice.

There are different decoration props from level structures down to small debris.

It comes with 16 handy blueprint tools making level art a lot easier.

Art Station page for more info and content regarding this product.

Showcase video presenting a walkthrough inside the environment.
metadata.technicalDetails:
Features:

  • AAA quality assets
  • Game Ready
  • Lods & Collision Ready
  • UE5 Ready
  • Competitive price for what you get
  • 16 handy Blueprints
  • Comes with a beautifully designed level suitable for lighting artists
  • Modular level structure models


Number of Unique Meshes: 484

Collision: Yes / Automatically

Vertex Count: from 2 (for small assets) to 150,499 (for hero objects)

LODs: Yes

Number of Materials and Material Instances: 133

Number of Textures: 250

Texture Resolutions: 512*512 / 4096*4096

Supported Development Platforms: Windows, Xbox One, Play Station 4

Windows: Yes

Mac: Yes

Science Fiction Valley village environment



Preview Video



Assets


SCI-FI valley village working with NANITE and LUMEN containing 99 static meshes on UE 5

You can also grab it for UE 4 with lods, lightmaps, collisions.

You will be able to use the level showcase or create your own with the assets you will get.

The showcase level is built with 4 zones and have interiors, landing pads, houses, and an open area for you to visit and ship flying above you !

Take a look at the Walkthrough video to see how it is built and how to customzie everything.

All assets are scaled according to the epic skeleton.

Be sure to enable distance fields in order to make lighting work fine on UE 4

Screen Fade Library
metadata.description: Plugin that makes it easy to implement screen fade in Blueprints and C++.
metadata.longDescription:
This plugin is also available on GitHub.


Screen Fade Library is a plugin that makes it easy to implement screen fade in Blueprints and C++. The plugin provides 6 Blueprint nodes and 3 C++ functions. It has advanced features that are not available in APlayerCameraManager::StartCameraFade.
metadata.technicalDetails:
Features:

  • Slate based (Higher performance than UMG, retained across levels)
  • Fade finished event
  • Fade audio
  • Fade when paused
  • Support splitscreen
  • Set Z-order

Code Modules:

  • ScreenFade (Runtime)

Number of Blueprints: 0

Number of C++ Classes: 5

Network Replicated: No

Supported Development Platforms: Windows 64-bit

Supported Target Build Platforms: Windows 64-bit

Documentation: https://github.com/suramaru517/ScreenFade

metadata.title: SICKA MANSION
metadata.description: Full Victorian Mansion Environment with nearly 200 prop ,character system and Drag and drop inspect object system
metadata.longDescription:
Gameplay Video

update 1.1 :BEDROOM Live (update the pack from launcher) Screenshot Preview

update 1.15: FOOD COLLECTION Live(update the pack from launcher) Screenshot preview

Full Victorian Environment with nearly 200 prop ,character system and inspect object system to be used directly or populate your own levels with similar theme.

  • ~200 Asset
  • hand-made Lightmap UV for all assets
  • High detail Props
  • atmospheric fog volume material
  • hybrid lighting of stationary and static(baked)
  • dust and fire Niagara particle system
  • high pixel density for textures with a hybrid of trim-sheet and overlapped texturing
  • material Variation for some of the objects
  • shared textures between multiple assets for best optimization
  • One master material for all props
  • Drag and drop Object Inspect blueprint
  • mesh outline system
  • character system with head-bob camera shake+flash light+interact
  • post process sharpen and outline material

metadata.longDescription:
<!--textBlock-->
<!--title-->
# ДОБРО ПОЖАЛОВАТЬ В ЗОНУ
<!--text-->
Чернобыльская Зона Отчуждения живет по своим правилам. Здесь нет безопасных маршрутов: в лесах живут агрессивные мутанты, на каждом шагу встречаются непредсказуемые аномалии, а другие Искатели в любой момент готовы перехватить твои трофеи.
<!--image-->
![STALCRAFT: X-mrrvn](https://cdn1.epicgames.com/spt-assets/bed02187768e44afb05319f40660d9fa/stalcraft-x-mrrvn.gif)
<!--textBlock-->
<!--title-->
# ГЛУБОКОЕ ПОГРУЖЕНИЕ
<!--text-->
Тебя ждет масштабный нелинейный сюжет на 50+ часов, где каждое решение будет влиять на развитие событий. Изучай истории обитателей Зоны и  выполняй сотни побочных квестов, каждый из которых станет настоящим испытанием на прочность. Участвуй в разнообразных сезонных активностях и масштабных тематических ивентах и получай эксклюзивные награды!
<!--image-->
![STALCRAFT: X-1spi8](https://cdn1.epicgames.com/spt-assets/bed02187768e44afb05319f40660d9fa/stalcraft-x-1spi8.gif)
<!--textBlock-->
<!--title-->
# ГЕЙМПЛЕЙ
<!--text-->
Зона не прощает ошибок, но щедро награждает победителей.  

Выбирай свой путь: 

**Перестрелки в открытом мире** — участвуй в клановых войнах, сессионках или перестрелках по пути на задание. Зона полна опасностей: от диких мутантов до других Искателей, поэтому каждая вылазка — риск потерять все самое ценное.

**Охота за артефактами** — исследуй отдаленные уголки Зоны в поисках артефактов, которые можно продать, обменять или использовать для собственных целей.

**Торговля** — добывай редкие артефакты, участвуй в аукционах, договаривайся о выгодном бартере — в STALCRAFT: X работает открытая экономика, где каждый может попробовать себя в роли торговца. 

**Войны группировок** — присоединись к вольнолюбивой Заре, военизированному Рубежу, беспринципным Наемникам или религиозному Завету! Борись за власть и укрепляй свое влияние в Зоне. 

Если тебе потребуется немного восстановиться после тяжелого боя и подготовиться к новым вылазкам, у тебя всегда будет свое убежище, которое можно обустроить на свой вкус.

*И самое главное* — в игре нет вайпов, это значит, что прогресс сохранится навсегда
<!--image-->
![STALCRAFT: X-6wz1t](https://cdn1.epicgames.com/spt-assets/bed02187768e44afb05319f40660d9fa/stalcraft-x-6wz1t.gif)
<!--textBlock-->
<!--title-->
# УНИКАЛЬНОЕ СОЧЕТАНИЕ FPS и RPG
<!--text-->
STALCRAFT: X — тактический шутер от первого лица в открытом мире, сочетающий динамичный FPS с элементами RPG.

Глубокая кастомизации оружия и большой выбор различных стволов позволяют собирать сеты под любой стиль игры — от легкого разведчика до штурмового экзоскелета.
<!--image-->
![STALCRAFT: X-yar7x](https://cdn1.epicgames.com/spt-assets/bed02187768e44afb05319f40660d9fa/stalcraft-x-yar7x.gif)
<!--textBlock-->
<!--title-->
# ЧЕСТНЫЙ FREE-TO-PLAY
<!--text-->
STALCRAFT: X придерживается честной F2P-модели: все ключевые предметы можно получить игровым путем. При необходимости комфортная система монетизации позволяет ускорить некоторые области прокачки персонажа или получить косметику.

Зона зовет, Искатель!
<!--image-->
![STALCRAFT: X-w9ssg](https://cdn1.epicgames.com/spt-assets/bed02187768e44afb05319f40660d9fa/stalcraft-x-w9ssg.gif)

Stats & Achievements Integration
metadata.description: Save your valuable time when implementing SteamAPI Stats & Achievements (... and more) for your Steam Game when you use the Stats & Achievements Integration plugin for blueprints!
metadata.longDescription:
A SteamAPI stats and achievements integration that will allow you to easily implement Steam stats and achievements using blueprints into your game. This plugin allows you to upload, download and, display user stats and achievements from the Steam servers.


This plugin works perfectly with the other plugins created by me:

  • Subsystem Configuration Integration
  • Leaderboard Integration
  • Friends Integration
  • Inventory Integration


Features:

  • Downloading user stats and achievement data from the steam servers.
  • Uploading user stats and achievement data from the steam servers.
  • Displaying achievement unlock/progress.
  • ...and much more!


﻿More features to come with future updates!
metadata.technicalDetails:
IMPORTANT

This plugin is safe to use on the client unlike the WebAPI. This plugin will not function properly without correctly setup stats & achievements within your Steamworks account that is linked with your Steam AppID. You can test this plugin with limited functionality by using the Spacewar AppID (480). Please use the documentation and example content as guidance; however it may require some tweaking within Blueprints to work with your personal Steamworks AppID.


Requires:

  • OnlineSubsystem
  • OnlineSubsystemUtils
  • OnlineSubsystemSteam

These should already come pre-installed with the engine and should be automatically enabled as soon as you enable the plugin within your project.


Plugin Contents

Number of Levels: 1

Number of Blueprints: 2

Number of C++ Classes: 8

Supported Target Build Platforms: Win64, Win32

To see all functions please see the documentation.


Disclaimer

This plugin does not have any association with VALVE. It only utilises the SteamAPI they provide for public use.

metadata.title: Stylized - Nanite Dungeon Pack
metadata.description: Craft your very own detailed dungeon with this bundle of 70+ assets. Check out the trailer video below for a closer look!
metadata.longDescription:
👑 This pack was featured as Unreal Engine Marketplace Sponsored Content for August 2024 👑


🎥 Trailer Video

🌐 Check out my website!


❖ Key Features ❖

  • A variety of more than 70 Nanite props, modular structural, blueprints, post-process, and particle effects.
  • Stylized 'Outline' and 'Sharpen' post-process materials. These shaders help highlight the meshes in your scene.
  • Niagara particle effects including Brazier Embers, Potion Whisps, and Ambient Dust.
  • A customizable light function that makes lights flicker.
  • Every material includes many parameters for tweaking the look and behavior of each material instance.


❗Update 1.1 (July 2024): Fixed issue with post-process exposure settings in levels.


Disclaimer:

  • This Project Supports Lumen for Unreal Engine 5.0+. Read the official Lumen documentation here.
  • This product supports Nanite for Unreal Engine 5.0+.
metadata.technicalDetails:
Texture Features:

  • All assets feature 2048x2048 (2K) resolution albedo & normal maps.
  • A 'Horror' themed lookup table texture that applies a spooky color palette to your scene.


Number of Unique Materials and Instances:

  • 1 master material with an array of parameters for customizing the appearance of every asset.
  • 83 material instances (these include the default parameters for each asset).
  • 2 post-process materials ('Outline' and 'Sharpen').
  • Particle and light function materials.


Number of Unique Meshes: 71 total static meshes.

metadata.longDescription:
Introducing the Survivors Roguelike Template, the ultimate game template for creating your own thrilling multiplayer experiences! Designed using 100% blueprints, this versatile asset comes packed with an array of features to help you create your dream game in no time.


With a robust ability system, level up system, and spawning system, the Survivors Roguelike Template provides you with all the tools you need to create dynamic gameplay experiences that will keep your players engaged for hours on end. And with its built-in multiplayer lobby, you can easily set up matches and invite friends to join in on the fun.

But that's not all – the Survivors Roguelike Template also includes data tables that allow you to manage all your game's information with ease. Whether you're tweaking stats, adding new items, or adjusting gameplay mechanics, this feature-packed asset makes it simple to create your own unique game.


So why wait? Get your hands on the Survivors Roguelike Template today and start creating the next big multiplayer sensation!


Used as a base for our TSS Game Rift Loopers

metadata.description: This spruce tree asset provides you with a collection of interactive & optimized tree models to make a natural looking forest.
metadata.longDescription:
This game ready asset provides you with a collection of interactive spruce trees (Picea abies).

The key of this asset is to have a cinematic looking but optimized trees for your next gen game!


[cinematic Trailer]

[interaction Trailer]

[performance Trailer] [NEW!]


Features and content:

This asset contains a number of 15 different tree meshes, showcasing different growth stages.

All tree parts are photoscanned separately and redesigned in a natural looking way.

Wind animation and interaction between character/animals/NPCs is fully made shader based!

Only 2 parameters to controll the whole wind settings of all placed foliage.

The interaction is replicated for multiplayer usage and easy to setup.


Performance optimization:

All plant parts are modeled on their own and as compact as possible.

For each big trees, there is a high and low vertex count version to fit the needs of your game.

That results in less quad overdraw and less shader complexity.

Optimized imposter for large landscapes without culling.


For the best possible support for this and many other products join our Discord!

[join Discord Community]
metadata.technicalDetails:

  • Project Nature Wind System 2.0:
  • only 2 parameters to change the wind animation of your whole vegetation
  • fully shader based
  • Project Nature Interaction System 2.0:
  • multiplayer replicated animations
  • support for NPCs, animals or physicals
  • fully shader based

  • easy customizable master materials
  • [2] Maps (big content showroom & interaction showroom)
  • [1] seamless forest ground texture set
  • [2] different needle leaf albedo textures
  • moss and snow blending materials
  • [7] big, [3] medium & [4] small trees
  • high and low vert count trees


Texture Sizes:

  • [1] Texture sets in (4096x4096) ground
  • [7] Texture sets in (4096x4096) imposter
  • [3] Texture sets in (4096x4096) tree

  • high vert trees: [LOD0 33k-21k] to [LOD3 16k-5k] average [LOD0 25k]
  • low vert trees: [LOD0 23k-7k] to [LOD3 5k-2k] average [LOD0 14k]

LODs: 4 + Imposter

metadata.title: Ultimate Farming
metadata.description: CropCraft Studios first asset pack of farming plants, props, and a greenhouse, planters, fields to create a realistic Farm-themed game.
metadata.longDescription:
45 types of plants : (Arugula, Barley, Beans, Beet, Berries, Blueberries, Broccoli, Cabagge, Cacao, Carrot, Cauliflower, Coffee, Corn, Cotton, Cucumber, Eggplant, Flax, Garlic, Grape, Hazelnut, Hemp, Jasmine, Lavender, Lattuce, Mint, Onion, Parsley, Peas, Pepper, Porcini Mushroom, Potato, Pumpkin, Rice, Rose, Spinach, Strawberry, Sugarcane, Sunflower, Tea, Tobacco, Tomatoes, Turnip, Watermelon, Wheat, Zucchini


Each plant species has up to 4 different variations. Additionally, each variation includes stages such as sprouted, growing, flowering, ready for harvest, and harvested, and their corresponding fruits. Additionally, a thumbnail image for each fruit.


Additionally, there are 10 types of dynamic planters, Greenhouse, props necessary for honey production, a beehive, and a bee swarm particle. There are also boxed versions of many fruits and vegetables, as well as various props. Total of 366 Meshes


All the updates we promised and shared in the roadmap for the years 2023-2024 have been completed. From now on, the new roadmap and updates will be applied only to the UltimateFarm Bundle product.



Video


Documentation



Also you can adjust the color tones of each plant using the smart material system. This system provides easy access to different color variations of the plants and allows you to customize the color tones as you desire.

For example : When creating a tomato field, you can simulate some of the tomatoes on the plants as ripened and red, while leaving others unripe and green for a more realistic effect.


All plants utilize a wind system. With the material parameter collection included in the product, you can change the wind intensity and direction at runtime whenever you want. Additionally, character interaction is also available within the product.


With this asset pack, you will have sufficient 3D content to easily simulate the entire process of each plant, from seed germination to fruit production.

metadata.description: Weapon Customization: Create 1300+ unique weapons, customize 7 parts, 6 skins, and Discover a wealth of exciting other features!
metadata.longDescription:
A video For all you need to know about the weapon customization system.
You can build your own shooting system with this customization system. But we also offer "DUSS," the dunpix ultimate shooting system with multiplayer support. It's compatible, always supported, and regularly updated!
Check out the Demo video preview here!
Contacts: LinkTree
Download and Play the DEMO here!
Get the system's free sound effects
the demo gameplay of the merged plugins "DUSS and ultimate customization system available for anyone interested in testing


#>Please note that the Ultimate Weapon Customization System (UWCS) is focused solely on weapon customization and does not include a "shooting system".<#


Introducing the Ultimate Weapon Customization System (UWCS): With UWCS, game developers can create over 1300 unique weapons by customizing seven different parts, providing players with endless possibilities and an engaging gameplay experience. The plugin features a user-friendly UI, a save system for up to six weapons with customized names, and automatic stat changes based on altered parts. Modifying the Handguard changes the weapon's element, while altering the Ammo transforms its bullet type, respectively. USWCS also offers six weapon skins for personalization and a smart analysis widget for strategic decision-making. A randomizing system adds surprise. Explore the limitless potential of weapon customization with USWCS!
metadata.technicalDetails:
Features:

  • 1: Seven customizable parts for tweaking weapon stats, offering endless possibilities for crafting various firearms.
  • 2: Personalized weapon skins with a wide array of colors.
  • 3: Ability to add custom skin colors from the editor, granting you control over the system's color palette.
  • 4: Customization Widget Analysis, providing insights into your weapon's strengths and weaknesses.
  • 5: Naming your customized weapon.
  • 6: Six slots for saving multiple customized weapons, each with a unique name, and the ability to select two for in-game use.
  • 7: Lock and Unlock System, allowing the use of virtual currency to unlock weapon parts.
  • 8: Saving system to preserve all edits, including customized parts, skins, slots, names, virtual currency balance, and unlocked parts.
  • 9: Custom parts system, enabling you to integrate your custom parts seamlessly into the system, complete with a comprehensive tutorial.
  • 10: The Anti-Cursing System, ensures a respectful gaming environment by detecting and preventing inappropriate language during weapon naming.
  • 11: Developer Tool integrated into the widget for testing and development, offering actions like clearing saved data, unlocking parts, and more.
  • Additional Noteworthy Features: Randomizing button, digitally styled environment with effects, optional sound downloads from the marketplace, in-game notifications for weapon effects, animated stats bar, fully designed widget, and a dedicated play level area.
  • 12: Multiplayer supported!

Number of Blueprints: 9 Blueprints, 10 Data table, 7 Structure, 13 WBP, 17 Enumeration

metadata.description: A collection of four brand new vehicles for absolutely free! Includes a Sedan, an SUV, a Box Truck and a Campervan!
metadata.longDescription:
Looking for something more? Check out the Advanced Version which is fully interactable!


Pack of 4 fully game ready, drivable vehicles with interiors for you to drop and use in your projects.


Includes:


  • Sedan
  • Box Truck (Delivery Variant)
  • SUV
